_comment: expectErrors lists rule IDs that MUST appear as error-severity findings for the file under the given profile. Arithmetic cascades may fire additional IDs alongside them (listed in mayAlsoFire); an empty expectErrors means zero error-severity findings are expected. Valid XRechnung files legitimately carry one information-level note (BR-DE-TMP-32), which is not an error.
